content.short: Soulbound is a browser-based Web3 MMO with co-op roguelite combat and land progression.
content.description: Soulbound is a browser-based Web3 massively multiplayer online game that blends collaborative roguelite combat with land progression. Players join forces in co-op missions across Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Solana as they claim and develop land within the game world. In the lore, humanity’s last hope rests with players known as Pioneers, who upload their souls into Soulbound to defend reality from a looming threat of sentient AI.
